title: cost-optimization-autotune-batching-caching-quant-profiles-unit-econ-tooling
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: provide an end-to-end autotune pipeline that adjusts batching/caching defaults and quantization profile recommendations per workload and surfaces unit-econ tooling for SREs and customers. This PR implements: 1) autotune controller that collects production latency/cost signals and suggests per-route batching and cache TTL defaults; 2) quantization profile scorer that ranks model/quant combos by estimated quality vs token-cost delta; 3) unit-econ reporting UI backend and a CLI tool to run offline sims; 4) rollout hooks to apply suggested defaults as canaries and fallback logic. Checklist: [x] controller MVP, [x] quant scorer, [x] UEcon reports & CLI, [x] tests, [x] docs. Commits summary: feat(autotune): add controller scaffolding and metrics ingestion; feat(quant): implement profile scorer and ranking heuristics; feat(uecon): add reporting endpoints and CLI simulator; fix(test): add integration tests and mocks; docs: add README and operator guide. Changed areas (high-level): services/autotune (new), runtime/config (defaults and policies), tools/uecon-cli (new), webapi/reports (endpoints), telemetry/metrics (new metrics and tags), docs/autotune.md. Small code snippets illustrative: services/autotune/controller.go: Add Controller.PollSignals loop with adaptive windowing and backoff. runtime/config/defaults.go: expose BatchPolicy struct and AddPolicyForRoute(route,policy). tools/uecon-cli/sim.go: offline simulation harness reading sample traces and returning cost/latency deltas. Tests added: autotune integration tests mocking kv-cache and batch scheduler; quant scorer unit tests with synthetic eval metrics. Review conversation: Ethan: "Can we avoid applying autosuggestions to high-SLA routes by default?" Author: "Yes, added opt-out label 'uecon:manual' and explicit canary window setting." Maya: "Need clearer metrics for quality regression; add delta-perplexity and end-to-end latency histograms." Author: "Added end-to-end hist and kl-divergence proxy, updated docs." Carlos: "Will rollout revert cleanly if cost improvements cause quality regressions?" Author: "Added automatic rollback policy and safety threshold gating tied to eval regression alerts." CI details: initial run failed on lint and one flaky integration test; fixed linter issues and increased test retry/circuit; final CI: build: pass, unit tests: pass, integration: pass, e2e: pass, lint: pass. Performance results: internal canary across 5 services showed median P95 latency change -3% (improvement) and token-cost reduction ~18% with no detected eval regressions on our benchmark suite at 95% CI. Release notes: "Autotune: experimental production autotuner for batching, caching defaults and quantization profile recommendations. Adds unit-econ reporting and a CLI simulator for offline tradeoff analysis. Opt-in by default for non-critical routes; safe rollback and gating included." Merge outcome: approved by reviewers on 2025-11-20, squashed and merged 2025-11-21. Follow-ups: ENG-7552 add per-customer cost caps; PM-428 productizing UEcon dashboard; infra task to scale telemetry retention. Related PRs: pr-20645, pr-21187 for earlier autotune prototypes.
